findings.sourceReading: Will says none of the Beatrices heard about so far was killed; they are trying to make it into a case of having been killed. This is Bernkastel’s true funeral.
findings.alternative: Trying to understand where killed factors in makes their activity an interpretive search for a pre-existing killing element. 殺されたことにしようとしている gives their activity a constructive or imposed framing. The adjacent Lion response remains about exposing what no one knows, so it does not license deleting Will’s distinct formulation.
